item.title: The Music Man
item.description:
Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: The Hobby Center, 800 Bagby St, Houston, TX 77002, United States, Houston, TX, 77002, United States

Seventy-six trombones. One unforgettable musical! Meredith Willson’s six-time Tony Award®-winning beloved musical comedy The Music Man marches into Houston with laughter, heart, and all the music you love. Following the fast-talking traveling salesman Harold Hill as he cons the people of River City, Iowa, into buying instruments and uniforms for a boys’ band that he vows to organize. Featuring songs such as “Seventy-Six Trombones,” “Trouble,” “’Till There Was You,” “Pick-a-Little,” and “Gary, Indiana,” The Music Man is a classic musical to be shared with every generation. CRITICAL ACCLAIM FOR THE MUSIC MAN – The Telegraph “A joyous, blissful Broadway event!” – Variety “Grand and Glorious!” “…totally enchanting abso-tootin’-lutely smashing revival. item.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
item.description:
Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: The Hobby Center, 800 Bagby St, Houston, TX 77002, United States, Houston, TX, 77002, United States

A new musical comedy about the things we do to stay together Based on the beloved film, Mrs. Doubtfire tells the hysterical and heartfelt story of an out-of-work actor who will do anything for his kids. It’s “the lovable, big-hearted musical comedy we need right now,” raves the Chicago Tribune – one that proves we’re better together. CRITICAL ACCLAIM FOR MRS.
